newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: PIMCO ties up with Singapore investment firm.
newsitem.headline: PIMCO ties up with Singapore investment firm.

text.p: Pacific Investment Management Company (PIMCO), part of PIMCO Advisors LP, said on Thursday it had linked up with Singapore's Pacific Asset Management (S) Pte Ltd.

The alliance lets PIMCO take up to 49 percent of Pacific Asset Management, which specialises in currency and fixed income funds management mainly in South East Asian markets, PIMCO said in a statement.
Edward Rennie, senior vice president of PIMCO told Reuters the company had taken some stake in the Singapore-based company but declined to reveal terms of the deal.
PIMCO, which opened a representative office in Singapore in 1996, manages US$88 billion in investments for large corporations, foundations, endowments and government bodies worldwide.
